sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000162-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Maple Grove Regional Hospital 162 on March 10, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 1.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Influenza share floor of 95%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: accepted by the Customer.
